note: Lisbon Park District campgrounds in Sandager Park on the Sheyenne River: the North Campground lies north of the FEMA dike inside a river bend, the West Campground at the dead end of Parkway Drive south of the dike; self-service with no check-in. Outdoor pool, mini golf, skate park, ball fields and courts. After a 2024 report of limbs at 13-15 ft scraping RV roofs, the district scheduled trimming of anything below 15 ft. --Claude
summary: City parks page (current, 2026 staff list) confirms North 10 sites 20/30/50A+water $25, West 10 full-hookup $30, primitive $10 FCFS, reservations required online (RoverPass) or by phone; now manual. Phone (701) 680-3736 confirmed. Riverfront doubtful: river ~29-33 m wide at the North Campground, pads ~18-25 m from it across the road and a broken brush fringe; West Campground is ~70 m from the river behind forest. Suggest creekside.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverfront stored; suggest creekside): measured on Esri imagery. The Sheyenne at the North Campground bend is ~29-33 m wide (water edge to edge at ~46.4482,-97.6890 and ~46.4472,-97.6889), right on the ~30 m creekside line. The North Campground's back-in pads sit on the west side of its loop, RVs at ~46.4484,-97.6882, ~46.4483,-97.6884, ~46.4481,-97.6884 and ~46.4476,-97.6884, rears ~18-25 m from the water across the campground road and a thin, broken shrub/tree fringe on the bank. No site map or site numbers published (city page and RoverPass name only 'North Campground' and 'West Campground' rates). The West Campground (RVs ~46.4459,-97.6897) is ~70 m from the river behind dense forest: not waterfront. On the default-down rule and a channel at the 30 m line, creekside is the safer call; riverview if the fringe is judged to block.
PHONE: stored (701) 680-3736 confirmed by the current parks page (reservations and pavilion). Google's 701-683-2158 is from the 2020 post and is superseded.

WEBSITE: suggest website = https://cityoflisbon.net/parks/ alone (the district's current page; it links RoverPass for booking, which now sits in booking.url). Drop the 2020 news post https://cityoflisbon.net/2020/06/10/sandager-park-update/ (which still says 'all sites are first come first serve') and the RoverPass line.

CLEARANCE: Google review (2024): 'all 4 had tree limbs hanging at 13ft to15ft that scraped the roof'; the park district replied it scheduled removal of branches below 15 ft. Fine for a rig under 10.5 ft; kept in the note.

SPLIT: two campgrounds ~300 m apart with separate entrances (North via Oak St and the brown building north of the dike; West at the Parkway Drive dead end), under the ~1 km split line; not a split candidate.
PIN: stored 46.4463,-97.6882 sits by the ball diamond between the two campgrounds (~190 m from the North pads, ~170 m from the West pads); under 250 m, no move.
